name: X-ray diffraction
description: Determines crystalline structure and phase composition from the angles and intensities of diffracted X-rays.

name: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy
description: Measures elemental composition and chemical state within the top few nanometres of a surface.

name: Scanning electron microscopy
description: Images surface topography and composition by scanning a focused electron beam across a specimen.

name: Transmission electron microscopy
description: Images internal structure at high resolution by transmitting electrons through a thin specimen.

name: Atomic force microscopy
description: Maps surface topography and mechanical properties by measuring forces between a sharp probe and the surface.

name: Raman spectroscopy
description: Identifies molecular and crystal vibrations from inelastic scattering of monochromatic light.

name: X-ray absorption spectroscopy
description: Probes local atomic environment and oxidation state from X-ray absorption near and above an element edge.

name: Synchrotron diffraction
description: Diffraction using high-brilliance synchrotron radiation, enabling fast, high-resolution or in-situ measurements.
